column1: # Archway emoji set — glyph<TAB>name and search keywords.
# Exactly one tab separates the glyph from the searchable text: everything after
# it is matched by rofi, so the visible label is also the keyword list. Two
# fields, not three — the picker reads field 1 as the glyph to copy from a line.
# Curated rather than exhaustive: the picker should be reachable by memory, and a
# 3.000-entry table makes every search slower to read. Keywords are what rofi
# filters on, so they carry the synonyms (English first, common Spanish second);
# the glyph and name are what you see.
# Order groups by intent (faces, hands, symbols, dev, objects, food, nature) and
# is preserved in the menu, so muscle memory survives additions at the end.
